bmi_definition: Latest valid recorded BMI in the 5 calendar years before admission, age >=18, value 10-100; no alternate BMI definition
clinical_status: Charlie ASCEND PLUS component codelists supplied 2025-09-10; CVD death uses underlying cause; GP MI retains the NHS acute-event subset
mace_definition: First MI, stroke (I60/I61/I63/I64 plus supplied SNOMED), or CVD death from the supplied 453-code list
cvdeath_definition: ONS underlying cause only, using Charlie CVD death v1.0
event_date_rule: First qualifying GP record, hospital admission or CVD death; no retrospective 30-day fatal/nonfatal reclassification; hospital admission must follow index admission
source_completeness_status: Confirm administrative source completeness before release
